messages:
maria: FYI - AWS account went into merchant verification after Stripe fallback. New card charges keep 3DS-failing, so our p4d quota request in eu-west-1 is stuck.
sam: ugh. Is this the account with the enterprise contract or the separate infra billing acct? :thinking:
maria: separate infra billing acct (acct-id: 123456789012). We tried to attach the company card and it failed 3DS from the bank (says 'suspicious activity'). AWS flagged it and paused some operations.
leo: Any AWS case opened? need that for quota escalation.
maria: opened case 6543210001 yesterday, support replied asking for proof of business + W-8/W-9 + recent bank statement. They put a soft hold: "Merchant verification in progress". Case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=6543210001
emily-support: thanks for the heads up. I can pull the exact email. Support wants: 1) company registration (PDF) 2) signed W-8BEN-E or W-9 3) bank statement (last 3 months) 4) copy of corporate cardholder ID if we want faster unblock.
rachel: Can finance provide W-9? We're US-taxed? I thought Redwood is Delaware corp so W-9 yes.
sam: finance here. I have W-9 ready but need a scanned business reg + bank statement. Maria, can you share which email AWS asked to send docs to? We should use the support case upload if possible.
maria: They said to upload to the case but also accept docs to billing-verifications@amazon.com. I'll attach a redacted bank stmt and reg cert now.
deploy-bot: deploy-redwood/inference:failed 2026-03-12T09:14:23Z - blocked due to capacity provisioning error (eu-west-1). Error: "InsufficientInstanceCapacity: merchant_verification_pending"
leo: That error is annoying because it mixes capacity with billing. For quota team we need the case escalated to merchant verification ops team. Emily, can you escalate? Add that production rollout depends on p4d-24xlarge quota.
emily-support: Escalating now. Filed priority escalation with support engineer (ENG-2345) and merchant ops. ETA: 48 hours but pushing for 8-12. I included the W-9 and reg cert attachments.
maria: bank put a temporary fraud hold, finance is on call to clear 3DS with the card issuer. Sam, can you also add a fallback payment method (company Amex) to prevent further fails?
sam: Added Amex ending in 1111 as backup. FYI billing portal shows last 3 failures with code 3DS_REQUIRED.
rachel: Meanwhile, ops - can we request quota in another region (us-west-2) to unblock testing? It doesn't solve eu-west traffic but helps CI.
leo: Yes we can request quota in us-west-2 as a stopgap. I'll open a separate quota request for p4d there and mark it separate from merchant hold case.
emily-support: Support replied to our escalation: "We cannot remove merchant verification hold until documents are validated. Once validated, merchant ops will clear within 6-24 hours. Quota requests will be processed after verification." They suggested adding a corporate registration number and signed W-9.
maria: Uploading the signed W-9 and company registration number now. Also asked bank to re-authorize the charge to trigger 3DS flow again.
deploy-bot: notice: auto-retry scheduled in 30m for the eu-west-1 provisioning request.
sam: finance confirmed with bank; they removed the hold and allowed a re-auth. Please re-run the charge and tell me if AWS accepts.
maria: Re-submitted payment and uploaded docs to case. Support updated case: "Documents received, under review by merchant ops." (Case 6543210001)
leo: Good. Keep the us-west-2 quota request open in parallel. If merchant ops clears, request can be fast-tracked.
emily-support: I'll follow up every 4 hours and ping the merchant ops contact. Adding @leo @maria to the escalation thread.
rachel: Thanks everyone. Once cleared we should run a smoke test: create 2 p4d instances, run a small benchmark, and validate routing. I'll prepare the runbook.
maria: Copy. Will update channel when AWS clears the hold.
